svg.title: When a client is ordered both a bronchodilator and a corticosteroid inhaler, the nurse teaches the client to use the {0} first, because doing so {1}.
svg.desc: The bronchodilator goes first so the airways are already open and the corticosteroid can deposit deep in the lungs instead of landing in the mouth and throat. Preventing thrush is a real concern, but that is handled by rinsing the mouth after the steroid, not by the order in which the inhalers are used.
